Synopsis:
A large wildfire in Serbia's Deliblatska Pescara nature reserve (northeastern Serbia) triggered activation of the EU Civil Protection Mechanism. Firefighting assets from Romania, Slovakia, Czech Republic, and Germany are being deployed. A Russian IL-76P plane is also assisting. Fires are also active in southwestern Serbia (Stolovi mountains) and neighbouring North Macedonia. Authorities flag strong winds as an immediate forward-looking risk. The event highlights continued pressure on EU emergency resources following a summer of repeated wildfires across Europe.
